description: Upstream fork-watch manifest. Each entry names one upstream this product tracks, the exact fork point our lineage last incorporated, and the downstream path classes that make an upstream commit conflict-relevant. scripts/upstream_watch.py turns this into a classified delta report.

upstreams.fork_point_meaning: upstream base of the mainline runtime tree every shipped lane now builds from (port/native-lanes-on-mainline; the RTX 5090 container lane moved onto it in v0.6.2). Supersedes the retired vendor/neroued-dev mirror point 4eef14a7, which was the container lineage's base before v0.6.2 and made this delta read 17 commits larger than it is.
vendored base of the native Windows 4090 lane (release/qwen38-4090-v0.1 lineage)
vendored base of the native Windows 3090 lane (port/omp-v0.2 lineage)
upstream v18.0.9 tag commit; the pinned patched client rebases downstream patches on this
